_comment: Fake data for the sample. Deliberately small, and deliberately messy in places (a late order, a backordered item, a customer with a prior complaint) so the agent has something real to reason about.

customers.name: Dana Whitfield
customers.notes: Escalated twice in 2025 over shipping delays. Values being told the truth early.

customers.name: Priya Raman
customers.notes: Buys in bulk for a school district. Needs invoices, not receipts.

policies.late_shipment: If an order passes its promised date, the customer may choose a full refund of shipping or a 15% credit on the order total. Gold-tier customers may take both. Never promise a new delivery date unless the item is in stock.
policies.backorder: Backordered items may be cancelled for a full refund at any time before shipment, or split-shipped at no extra cost so in-stock items go out immediately.
policies.refund_window: 30 days from delivery for any reason. 90 days for a defect.
policies.escalation: Any customer with two or more prior complaints goes to a named human owner, not a queue. Say who will follow up.
